name: Impro Precision Industries Limited
summary: Impro Precision Industries Limited provides casting products and precision machining parts in the Americas, Europe, and Asia. It operates through Investment Casting, Precision Machining and Others, Sand Casting, and Surface Treatment segments. The company offers components for fuel systems, electric fuel injection and exhaust systems, transmission systems, hydraulic orbital motors and tool parts, engine blocks, cylinder heads, emission and engine systems, marine engines and steering systems, motorcycle brakes, exhaust gas recirculation and body systems, motor shafts, and turbo chargers, body systems, and motor shaft for electric vehicles.
